Meeting Schedule

Meetings are held in Room 1101 at the California Department of Education, which is located at 1430 N Street, Sacramento, California 95814. Please see the Meeting Notice/Agenda for information on how to participate in a meeting.

Meeting Notices, Agendas, and Minutes

ACCS meeting notices, agendas, and minutes are posted online for the current calendar year and for the previous five calendar years. Individual ACCS agenda items are removed from the website after two calendar years. Please contact the Charter Schools Division by email at charters@cde.ca.gov to request meeting notices, agendas, minutes, and agenda items not posted on the website.
